definitions: A set of outer clothes made of the same fabric and designed to be worn together, typically consisting of a jacket and trousers or a skirt.
Any of the four sets of 52 playing cards (spades, hearts, diamonds, and clubs).
A request made to a person in a position of authority.
examples: He wore a dark grey suit to the interview.
The company filed a suit against its competitor.
She made a suit for more funding.
